htf_trend.definition: On each fully closed 4h candle: EMA(50) of 4h close. BULL if close>EMA50 and EMA50>EMA50_prev; BEAR if close<EMA50 and EMA50<EMA50_prev; else NEUTRAL. Mapped to 1h decision via selected_4h_close_time <= decision_time.

setup_pullback.definition: Window of prior 8 completed 1h bars. LONG: 4h BULL AND at least one window low <= EMA(20) at that bar AND decision close > window max high AND decision close > EMA(20). SHORT: 4h BEAR AND at least one window high >= EMA(20) AND decision close < window min low AND decision close < EMA(20).

continuation.LONG: 1h close breaks above max high of the completed pullback window
continuation.SHORT: 1h close breaks below min low of the completed pullback window

ablations.A1: A0 + ATR percentile <= 50 descriptive volatility gate (predeclared, not optimized)
ablations.A2: UNAVAILABLE WITHOUT ENGINE CHANGE — causal retest after continuation not in base S1 engine without new fill model
